title: madhuca pallida
intro: Madhuca pallida, commonly known as the Himalayan butter tree, is a plant species belonging to the Sapotaceae family. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and reduce the risk of cardiovascular diseases due to its rich content of unsaturated fats and antioxidants. The therapeutic actions of Madhuca pallida are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, and have shown potential in treating conditions such as inflammation, diabetes, and cancer. The bioactive constituents of Madhuca pallida have also been found to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a valuable resource for natural medicine.
